text: CORRECTION after close: this lane's own CP1 (_inbox/2026-09-01_zoning-band1_cp1.json) was written by overwriting an existing CP1 from the 2026-09-01 killed lane without reading it first (DEV_PROCESS 3.3b violation). The original specified prop-ids-file-scoped stamping via landing_parcel_jurisdiction to avoid unscoped-PIP bleed; this lane ran unscoped anyway and, cross-checked against that same containment table after the fact, found real cross-jurisdiction mis-stamps in all 8 cities (84-650 parcels each, 1249 total) plus 12 Robinson-run parcels that clobbered pre-existing correct Waco stamps. All corrected: cross-jurisdiction/unincorporated mis-stamps nulled, the 12 Waco parcels restored via a scoped re-run of the already-wired waco-tx layer. Final post-correction counts, the full incident account, and updated fleetMemory are in the close.json now being committed. Original CP1 content is recoverable via git log on this path before this addendum's commit.
